parent_objective: design adaptive closed-loop bracketing over M811 collision/safe edges

public_gates: M813 must preserve the P0 human-view actor contract
M813 must keep alpha 0.2 and primary <=0.00005 margin threshold unchanged
M813 must design adaptive bracketing without training actor residual or calibrator parameters
M813 must keep calibration PPO and promotion blocked
forbidden_shortcuts: do not train actor or residual parameters
do not train a new residual calibrator
do not add oracle deploy-time inputs
do not widen the primary 0.00005 margin threshold
do not treat fixed-grid sparse output as a pass
do not claim true wheel-level faults from current proxy data
do not tune from private holdout failures

workflow_synthesis.evidence_axis: G_distribution: adaptive source-diverse near-boundary bracketing design
workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: designs a deterministic bracket refinement route after M812 classified M811 as fixed-grid boundary-resolution miss
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: design only; no residual calibration PPO or driver promotion
stop_condition: stop if design weakens the primary margin gate
stop if design depends on training or PPO
stop if design cannot preserve source and axis diversity gates
stop if design overclaims current-model proxy faults as wheel-level fidelity
fallback_plan: if adaptive bracketing is not viable, pivot to source-route or simulator-fidelity synthesis
if brackets are too sparse, design a larger bracket harvest before refinement
if bracket refinement becomes geometry-only, require audit before calibration
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M813 follows M812 audit in the v4_low_margin_new_data_route branch

hypothesis: A deterministic adaptive bracketing route can resolve M811 collision/safe edges into the strict primary low-margin band without weakening thresholds or training parameters.
success_criteria: M813 specifies source bracket selection from M811 artifacts
M813 specifies bracket refinement axes and stopping criteria
M813 preserves no-training no-PPO and no-promotion invariants
M813 names the implementation blocker explicitly
failure_criteria: M813 weakens the primary margin threshold
M813 admits calibration or PPO before primary rows exist
M813 omits source or axis diversity gates
M813 treats geometry-only primary rows as a source-diverse pass
decision_rule: M813 may only design an adaptive no-training data route. It must not run implementation, calibration, PPO, or promotion.
